issues.description: flattenRef has no stated invariant and parent-branch recursion lacks a termination guard analogous to seen.ref=null.
issues.detail: flattenRef now recurses on both seen.ref and seen.parent while mutating schema in place. Only the ref branch nulls its sentinel; the parent branch has no analogous guard, so termination depends on traversal order rather than a stated well-founded relation. State the precondition, postcondition, and invariant, or add an explicit visited set for parent chains.

issues.description: JSON.stringify is used as structural equality in two hot dedup loops.
issues.detail: Both dedup loops compare child and parent property values via JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b). This is key-order sensitive, drops undefined, mishandles NaN/Infinity, and is O(n*size) per node. Define a real structural equality over JSON Schema fragments and use it once, rather than smuggling equivalence through serialization.

issues.description: override callback semantics silently changed; overrideCount doubled from 6 to 12 with no rationale.
issues.detail: The previous `if (!seen.isParent) override(...)` guard was removed so override now fires for parent nodes as well. The test was updated from 6 to 12 as a snapshot rather than a specified contract change. Either restore the guard or document the new override contract in code and changelog so external consumers know what to expect.

issues.description: Seen complects inheritance source, clone lineage, and visited flag into overloaded fields.
issues.detail: Seen.ref carries three states (undefined, $ZodType, null) acting as both inheritance source and visited sentinel, while Seen.parent overlaps as clone lineage. flattenRef then disambiguates via isParentRef = (zod.parent === ref). Separate the inheritance edge, the clone-lineage edge, and the visited flag into distinct named fields so the merge can be expressed as a pure function.

issues.description: Correctness of the new $ref propagation rests entirely on inline snapshots.
issues.detail: The only evidence for when children inherit parent properties, when duplicates are deleted, and when $ref propagates up the chain is toMatchInlineSnapshot output. Snapshots show presence of behaviour, not correctness. State invariants for each of the three rules so a maintainer can reason about them without rerunning the suite.

issues.description: play.ts is committed as a scratchpad with local source imports and console.log debugging residue.
issues.detail: play.ts was repointed from `zod/v4` to a relative path into the package and filled with console.log cases for manual investigation. This is author scratch, not artifact. Delete it from the PR or promote the two cases into named tests under tests/ so the repo carries specifications, not debugging notes.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch correctly separates ref-inheritance from clone-lineage, but ships the fix as under-specified mutation rather than a reasoned algorithm. flattenRef recurses across two chains while mutating schema in place, with a termination sentinel on only one branch and no stated invariant. JSON.stringify stands in for structural equality in two hot loops, the override callback contract changed silently (overrideCount jumped 6 to 12 by snapshot), and correctness rests entirely on inline snapshots. A scratch play.ts is also left in the diff. Action: state invariants, define real structural equality, document or revert the override change, and remove play.ts.
